where: The masquerade ball: a long hall of marble columns under gilded arches, a painted barrel vault, three great chandeliers, red velvet at the tall windows, banquet tables and a gem display in the west aisle. Masked guests in lavish costumes talk in pairs across the floor. At the far end a stage hung with the house's banners and red drapes, a curtained cage on its west half. Glazed doors in the east wall stand open onto a moonlit balcony. The party has just come in by the grand doors.
